### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **1** documentable anchor(s).

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `/api/v1/meta (route, 46 pages)`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 45efba2a5b0ccb12b16160b5b177b46416dbf359` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `357df647e8d8ceeb0aac74a27293a6532f234190` — the merge of head `e9437cd81677eaa995767ca4181582748dfc5e97` into base `45efba2a5b0ccb12b16160b5b177b46416dbf359`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 357df647e8d8ceeb0aac74a27293a6532f234190 && git checkout 357df647e8d8ceeb0aac74a27293a6532f234190
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 45efba2a5b0ccb12b16160b5b177b46416dbf359 e9437cd81677eaa995767ca4181582748dfc5e97 && git checkout -B drift-repro 45efba2a5b0ccb12b16160b5b177b46416dbf359 && git merge --no-ff e9437cd81677eaa995767ca4181582748dfc5e97

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 45efba2a5b0ccb12b16160b5b177b46416dbf359
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 45efba2a5b0ccb12b16160b5b177b46416dbf359` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e9437cd81677eaa995767ca4181582748dfc5e97`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts + packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine.ts, packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts, packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/environment-artifact.zod.ts, packages/spec/package.json

Inputs read: card #28855 body and its three comments (claim, os-dev-report, seat's hand-off note); PR #28873 body, file list (2 paths), net diff (+16/−2); the head's check-runs, fetched twice. Code read with `git show prr-28873:…` and `git show origin/main:…` only.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set: unchanged.** The diff touches one `//` comment inside `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` and adds a changeset. The `object_extension` row literal (type, label, description, `filePatterns`, `supportsOverlay`, `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, `allowRuntimeCreate`, `supportsVersioning`, `executionPinned`, `loadOrder`, `domain`) is byte-identical to `origin/main`. No schema, key, enum or export moves — **right**.
- **Public surface: shipped bytes move, types do not.** `packages/spec/package.json` `files[]` carries `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so the edited file is in the published tarball; `dist/` and `.d.ts` are unaffected because a `//` comment is not emitted. The PR body's reading of `files[]` matches the tree — **right**.
- **Generated output: none owed.** The row literal is unchanged, so `content/docs/references/kernel/metadata-plugin.mdx`, `meta-url-data.generated.ts`, JSON Schema and the api-surface baselines have nothing to pick up; the Docs Drift Check comment lists three pages by the `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` symbol, none of which restates the sentence this PR corrects (`git grep` for the old wording finds only `protocol-object-extension-item.ts` L7–8, filed as #28874) — **right** to regenerate nothing.
- **Check-runs on the head** (re-fetched this round): 24 `success`, 13 `skipped`, 29 `in_progress` (Build Core, Test Core 1–8, Test UI 1–16, Type Check workspace, Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI), 0 `failure`. **Pending, not green**: landing waits for them; nothing here can be assumed.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/28855-object-extension-registry-comment.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, body carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` as line-initial declarations; the PR body carries the same two lines. **Correct.**
- `patch` over `skip-changeset`: AGENTS.md §Post-Task Checklist 3 reserves `skip-changeset` for "a diff that publishes nothing from any released package". `src/**/*.zod.ts` is a published file of `@objectstack/spec`, so this diff publishes something, even though no `.d.ts` or runtime byte changes. The card's own test ("judge by `files[]`") lands on the same side, and the repo precedent is the same: `892eb668f6` (#28827), a text-only edit to `object.zod.ts`, shipped a `patch` changeset. **`patch` is right; `skip-changeset` would have been wrong.**
- `Clause-②: no` with no arm: nothing a consumer can author, import or receive widens or narrows; `Metadata-protocol: none` follows. `none` takes `patch` per the rule. **Consistent.**

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions: []` in the os-dev-report — nothing to answer.
- `deviations`: "Fixes line is line 3 of the PR body, after the harness attribution block". Read on the PR body: `Fixes #28855` is the first content line after the attribution block, with no other closing keyword. **Accepted** (the seat accepted it too).
- `out_of_scope_findings`: the same false sentence in the header of `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts` (L7–8). Verified present at the head; the seat filed it as **#28874** (open, `finding`). **Routed, nothing left dangling.**
- One further site this review found that neither the dev nor #28874 names, outside `hits` and outside this PR's package: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` L9303–9305 (docblock of `foldObjectExtendersFromRegistry`) says a compiled-artifact ingest "registers `objects` and `objectExtensions` into that service as SEPARATE collections". The conclusion the docblock draws (the MetadataService body is the owner's unfolded declaration) still holds, but the mechanism sentence is the same drift this PR corrects. **Escalated to triage** as an addendum for #28874 or its own finding; it does not bear on this verdict.
- Serial constraint named in the claim (#28519 may regenerate `metadata-plugin.mdx`): this diff feeds no generated file, so no merge conflict class is opened. **Cleared.**

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts` — the rewritten comment, judged sentence by sentence against the code at the head.

1. *"A code package declares its extensions in `objectExtensions`, and they are never stored as items of this type"* — **holds.** Every door a code package's `objectExtensions` can enter was read: (a) the artifact door, `MetadataPlugin._parseAndRegisterArtifact` → `registerArtifactBodyCollections` (`packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts` L499–597), whose per-item gate is `artifactItemSlot` (L324–336); (b) the residual rule, where `RESIDUAL_TYPES_WITH_OWN_PATH` in `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` L187–191 excludes `object_extension` by name with the same reason; (c) the config door and the marketplace install door, which both reach `ObjectQL.registerApp`; (d) the stored-row hydration, `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` (`protocol.ts` L19036–19043), which registers a stored row "never as an item". None files `(object_extension, NAME)` from a package body.
2. *"the ObjectQL engine's `registerApp` registers each one as an `'extend'` contributor of its target object"* — **holds.** `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` L9201 declares `registerApp(...)`; step 2b at L9378–9401 builds `extDef` with `name: targetFqn` and calls `this._registry.registerObject(stampPackage(extDef, id, version), id, undefined, 'extend', priority)`.
3. *"The artifact loader maps that collection to this type name but files no item from it, because an extension carries `extend` and no `name`"* — **holds, and is the stronger truth.** `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE` at `plugin.ts` L132 maps `objectExtensions: 'object_extension'`. `artifactItemSlot` reads `item.name` and falls back to an object derivation only for `metaType === 'view'`; an extension has neither, so `slot` is `undefined` and the loop `continue`s before any `sink.register`. Tried to break it with a raw `name` on an entry: all three branches of `_parseAndRegisterArtifact` (L1363, L1370, L1376) parse the metadata through `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` (`EnvironmentArtifactSchema.metadata` is that schema, `environment-artifact.zod.ts` L132), whose `objectExtensions` is `z.array(ObjectExtensionSchema)` (`stack.zod.ts` L754), and whose `packages[].manifest` bodies (`AssembledPackageBodySchema`, L1865–1868) extend `ManifestSchema` with the same full collection declarations (`assembledPackageBodyShape`), so a body's entries parse the same way; `ObjectExtensionSchema` is `strictObject` with `name` in its `aliases` table, which per `strict-object.ts` is a key the shape *rejects* with a prescription, so a `name` never reaches the slot derivation — the artifact is refused before the loop. `defineObjectExtension` (`object.zod.ts` L5010) is `ObjectExtensionSchema.parse`, so a code package's compiled entries carry `extend` only. The comment's reason is exactly the code's reason.
4. *"This type's items are the stored rows the `/api/v1/meta` doors write"* — **holds; no door is left out.** Save and publish gate through `objectExtensionItemRefusal` (`protocol.ts` L22168–22175, L24310–24315) with the body judged by `OBJECT_EXTENSION_ITEM_SCHEMA` (L1077–1080); the write-through registers the row as the package's `'extend'` contributor (L19838–19850); delete withdraws it (L7874–7908); the export door (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` L3308–3316) reads the stored items back out as the package's `objectExtensions` entries. The unchanged first paragraph of the same comment already names draft, publish, history, rollback, delete and export, so the two paragraphs now describe one closed loop: a stored item exports as an `objectExtensions` entry, and on install that entry registers as `'extend'` and is never re-stored as an item — the new sentence and the old paragraph agree. `git grep` finds no other writer of `object_extension` rows (CLI, cloud-connection, core: none).
5. The sentences the PR did not touch in the hunk (`filePatterns` rationale, `supportsOverlay` / `allowEnvironmentOverlay: false`, the `BUILTIN_METADATA_TYPE_SCHEMAS` exclusion) still read true against `protocol.ts` L1077–1080 and `protocol-object-extension-item.ts`; the rewrite introduces no contradiction with ADR-0146 D10 (which places the extension in `.custom` and names no artifact-loader item) or with `object.zod.ts` L4686 ("the LOADER picks `extend`", which is the ownership kind, not an item slot).

**Findings:** no must-fix. No should-fix inside `hits`. One out-of-scope observation (③, `protocol.ts` L9303–9305), escalated.
